description.zh: 验证已确认的 XSS 输出点能否在隔离浏览器中加载授权 BeEF 实例的 hook.js，并以脚本请求和测试会话作为执行证据。
description.en: Validate whether a confirmed XSS sink can load hook.js from an authorized BeEF instance in an isolated browser, using the script request and test session as execution evidence.

subCategory.zh: 外部 Hook 脚本加载

description.zh: 在隔离测试页面加载已授权 BeEF 实例的 Hook 脚本。
description.en: Load the hook script from an authorized BeEF instance in an isolated test page.

analysis.zh: 成功证据必须同时包含可执行 DOM、hook.js 请求和隔离 BeEF 会话；只有 URL 可达或前端显示变化不足以确认。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires an executable DOM, a hook.js request, and an isolated BeEF session; URL reachability or a UI-only change is insufficient.

opsecTips.zh: 只连接自有测试实例，并使用无真实 Cookie、账号或扩展的隔离浏览器配置。
opsecTips.en: Connect only to an owned test instance and use an isolated browser profile without real cookies, accounts, or extensions.

opsecTips.zh: 设置短测试窗口，完成后删除记录、关闭会话并停止 BeEF 服务。
opsecTips.en: Use a short test window, then remove records, close sessions, and stop the BeEF service.

title.zh: 确认 HTML 解析边界

description.zh: 用随机文本和无害标签确认输入进入目标 Sink，并记录编码、DOM 与 CSP 基线。
description.en: Use a random marker and harmless tag to confirm the target sink and record encoding, DOM, and CSP baselines.

description.zh: 在隔离测试浏览器提交 Hook 标签，关联脚本请求、控制台与 BeEF 测试会话。
description.en: Submit the hook tag in an isolated browser and correlate the script request, console, and BeEF test session.

title.zh: 排除网络与预加载假阳性
title.en: Exclude network and preload false positives

description.zh: 比较 CSP 阻断、纯文本 Sink 和禁用扩展的结果，确认脚本实际执行而非仅发生请求。
description.en: Compare CSP-blocked, text-only, and extension-disabled cases to prove execution rather than a request alone.

description.zh: 应用上下文编码和严格 CSP，删除测试记录与会话，再重放相同输入确认只显示文本。
description.en: Apply context-aware encoding and strict CSP, remove test records and sessions, and replay the input to confirm text-only rendering.

overview.zh: 本条只描述 XSS Sink 中的 Hook 标签，不再混入 BeEF 安装、控制台和模块清单。验证前应先用普通标记确认输入进入 HTML 解析上下文，再在隔离测试浏览器和自有 BeEF 实例之间建立可回滚的观测链。
overview.en: This entry covers only the hook tag placed in an XSS sink; BeEF installation, console use, and module references belong to the tool card. Confirm the HTML parsing context with a plain marker before using an isolated browser and an owned BeEF instance for observable, reversible validation.

vulnerability.zh: 应用把不可信输入拼入 HTML 而未按上下文编码或消毒，浏览器因此创建外部 script 元素。若 CSP 还允许该脚本源，页面会请求 hook.js 并在当前源的浏览器上下文中执行；BeEF 只是观测执行的框架，根因仍是 XSS 输出边界失效。
vulnerability.en: The application inserts untrusted input into HTML without context-aware encoding or sanitization, causing the browser to create an external script element. If CSP permits the source, hook.js is fetched and executed in the page context. BeEF observes the result, while the root cause remains the failed XSS output boundary.

exploitation.zh: 先提交随机文本并记录最终 DOM；再在隔离浏览器加载本条 Hook，关联 hook.js 网络请求、控制台错误和 BeEF 测试会话；随后用被编码的同值、禁止外部脚本的 CSP 和纯文本 Sink 对照，排除预加载、浏览器扩展或仅网络可达但未执行等假阳性。完成后关闭测试会话并删除记录。
exploitation.en: Submit a random marker and record the final DOM, then load this hook in an isolated browser and correlate the hook.js request, console errors, and BeEF test session. Compare an encoded value, a CSP that blocks external scripts, and a text-only sink to exclude preloading, browser extensions, or network reachability without execution. Close the test session and remove the record afterward.

mitigation.en: Encode separately for HTML text, attributes, URLs, and JavaScript contexts; use a maintained sanitizer for required rich text; deploy a strict nonce- or hash-based CSP with constrained connect-src; avoid dangerous DOM APIs such as innerHTML; and replay the same regression value in administrative, export, and notification sinks.
